column5: GROUP: **optimization-unit-semantics, `current_ownership.rs` (22)** | 25. `CO:9530-9542` `moving` returns `Ok` for any non-`Owned` root or a path that leaves inline storage. Wrong program: "moving out of a borrowed root or through an indirection is not checked here".
GROUP: **optimization-unit-semantics, `current_ownership.rs` (22)** | 26. `CO:9578-9580` `observing` the same for a non-`Owned` root.

GROUP: **optimization-unit-semantics, `current_ownership.rs` (22)** | 27. `CO:9609-9622` `observing` returns at the first prefix that leaves inline storage; a claim frontier below an indirection is not checked by this function.
GROUP: **optimization-unit-semantics, `current_ownership.rs` (22)** | 28. `CO:9730` `observations` ends `_ => Ok(())`; `StructuralLeafCopy` with a non-`Ordinary` path falls there.

GROUP: **optimization-unit-semantics, `current_ownership.rs` (22)** | 29. `CO:9799-9816` `install_store` removes the stored value's claims and reinserts them only when the destination is owned. Wrong program: "a stored value's claims vanish when the destination is a borrowed parameter".

GROUP: **optimization-unit-semantics, `current_ownership.rs` (22)** | 30. `CO:9943-9947` a content-entry claim whose root is not a structural parameter is recorded with `input: None`; checks that filter by `claim.input == Some(place)` will not see it.

GROUP: **optimization-unit-semantics, `descriptor_results.rs` (4)** | 31. `DR:2340-2341` a caller-supplied `preserves_boundary` closure returning `true` makes a boundary call non-escaping; non-default users at pipeline 03 `legalization_descriptor_inputs.rs:64` and pipeline 02 `references.rs:1536` not traced.

GROUP: **optimization-unit-semantics, `descriptor_results.rs` (4)** | 32. `DR:2242-2272` a call to a machine outside the catalog is non-escaping when the result is Unit or Scalar, there are no claim transfers and every non-shared argument has closed storage.
